sloka: स्पर्शिता राजसिंहेन मम दत्ता नृगेण ह ।तयोर्ब्राह्मणयोर्वादो महानासीद्विपश्चितोः ।। ७.५३.१५ ॥
transliteration: sparśitā rājasiṁhena mama dattā nṛgeṇa ha ।tayorbrāhmaṇayorvādo mahānāsīdvipaścitoḥ ।। 7.53.15 ॥

translations.english: One brahmin claimed the cow was touched by the king, while the other insisted it was given to him by Nṛga, leading to a great dispute between the two learned brahmins.
